raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "answer to the page"
      role subject "Andrei"
      polarity negated
      role time ?t
    end
    match
      relation "be next on escalation"
      role subject ?who
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  select ?who
  during "15 minutes"
